methodology: Codex independently reopened the direct manager and company sources, recorded access behavior, and hashed retrieved bytes. The ArcLight ESG report was downloaded from the official manager site, text-extracted, rendered, and visually checked on the portfolio table page. Search snippets were used only to locate blocked pages and were not used as the sole basis for the final after-image.

verifiedClaims: ArcLight's live investments table lists Zeem as a Current transformative-infrastructure investment.
The current listing supports retaining one active ArcLight ownership period and the subsequent-exit check.
ArcLight's portfolio table lists Zeem under Fund VII.
The report classifies Zeem as a transformative investment.
Zeem provides commercial EVs, charging depots and managed charging services.
The company is an operating platform rather than an individual depot or project.
Zeem's current official press page states that the company was founded in 2017.
The current news archive evidences continuing operations through 2026.
Zeem says it is headquartered in Los Angeles, California.
The page lists shared charging depots in Inglewood, Long Beach and SeaTac.
The official privacy notice identifies the company as Zeem Solutions, Inc.

databaseSourceMetadata.label: Investment date source — ArcLight Capital Partners — Zeem Solutions

verifiedClaims: Zeem announced a $50 million capital commitment from a fund managed by ArcLight on July 6, 2022.
The release ties the investment to ArcLight's energy-transition infrastructure strategy.
LAZ Parking Realty Investors was described prospectively as an equity partner; the release does not establish its legal closing or current ownership.
Zeem reported more than 350,000 charging sessions and 13.4 million kWh delivered at its LAX depot by May 2026.
The current operating update supports continued company activity after ArcLight's 2022 investment.
An ArcLight corporate post attributes the investment to Fund VII and describes it as made in June 2022.
sources.notes: The final proposal uses the year 2022 only because the exact legal closing date is not publicly disclosed and stronger official evidence supports the July 6 announcement rather than an exact closing day.

verifiedClaims: The filing identifies the exact legal fund name ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, L.P.
sources.notes: The official filing was browser-accessible to the research worker but direct command-line retrieval returned 403. Fund VII is independently confirmed for Zeem by ArcLight's 2025 report and by the production Fund dependency.

modelEvidenceCorrections.claim: Zeem is headquartered in Inglewood, California.
modelEvidenceCorrections.reason: Zeem's current locations page says it is headquartered in Los Angeles; Inglewood is one of its charging-depot locations.

modelEvidenceCorrections.claim: The exact ownership entry date is June 2022.
modelEvidenceCorrections.reason: Public sources establish a June reference and a July 6 announcement but do not disclose the exact legal closing day. The structured ownership record retains investmentYear 2022 without inventing a date.

modelEvidenceCorrections.claim: LAZ Parking Realty Investors is a current Zeem owner.
modelEvidenceCorrections.reason: The 2022 release described LPRI prospectively as an equity partner, but no legal closing or current direct ownership evidence was identified.

modelEvidenceCorrections.claim: The $50 million commitment was a Series A financing.
modelEvidenceCorrections.reason: The official release calls it a capital commitment/investment and does not identify a Series A security class.

exitSearchConclusion: No Zeem-level sale, completed exit, signed pending ownership transfer, dissolution, successor or rename was identified through 2026-08-15. ArcLight's live investments page continues to list Zeem as Current, and Zeem's current website reports continuing operations through 2026.
